rationale: Preserve scan relief on a 15.625 mm near grid, reduce the grid by four per tier; small original grass retains complete blades. Shared 2k color and normals retain 1024 texels/metre; lower-frequency roughness uses 1k. Runtime resource set fits the 16 MiB encoded resident cache.
grassUvException: Original solid-color blades have no sampled image detail; their constant UVs are intentional. Duplicate back faces supply sidedness without an extra pipeline.
